construction.physical_operation: Select complete centrally symmetric owners at an actual marked host face, edge or vertex. Retain all60 host walls and an actual directed separating plane for every pair. Reconstruct every owner translation together. Continued returns replace ports only by separating faces of the realized pair. All owners retain the same proper canonical orientation.
construction.pair_rule: Each pair requires a dot(c_j-c_i)>=h_P(a)+h_P(-a), using actual canonical supports.

contribution.method:
New complete finite polyhedron constructions from exact classical lattice sources, marked boundary returns, compatible common-center continuations and whole-owner deletion. All source frames, complete predecessor geometries, common host walls and pair separators are retained. Original source and donor authors are credited in the archive. These are new physical constructions, not wall-padding refinements.

All 32 witnesses passed independent source, decoder, complete geometry and current-baseline review, both unmodified upstream 3D checkers, and the trusted archive parser. The archive binds native coordinates, full physical construction decoders, reviews, source evidence and SHA256 checksums. No global optimality is claimed.
